questions.question: Norman Ernest Borlaug was awarded the _____ in 1970 for his contributions to the green revolution.

questions.question: In cost theory, the usual shape of the ________ curve is a rectangular hyperbola.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**average fixed cost**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **AFC** is the average fixed cost per unit of output,** calculated by dividing total fixed costs by the quantity of output produced**.
 
• ​**Behavior**: AFC decreases as output increases since fixed costs remain constant, but they are spread over more units of output.
 
• **Graph Shape:** The AFC curve is downward sloping and never touches the axes, indicating that as output rises, AFC approaches but never reaches **zero**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rectangular Hyperbola**

 
 
• Geometerically, it is a curve where (x,y) co-ordinates of the production at any point on the curve becomes constant.
 
• The graph indicates inverse relationship.
 
 
 
• **Some other important Cost curves:**
 
 
• **Total Cost Curve: **It is the sum of Total fixed costs and Total Variable Costs. 
 
• **Average Cost Curve (Average Total Cost): **it is the ratio of Total cost to the quantity of output produced.
 
• **Marginal cost: **It is additional cost of producing one more unit of output.

questions.question: What is the name of the festival that ends the Holy Ramzan month?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Eid-Ul-Fitr.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Eid al-Fitr, also known as the "**Festival of Breaking the Fast**," is celebrated by Muslims worldwide.
 
• It is celebrated to **mark the end of Ramadan**, a month of fasting, prayer, and reflection.
 
• It is a day of joy and thanksgiving to Allah for the strength and patience shown during the month of fasting.
 
• The festival is also a time for community prayers, and giving charity (known as **Zakat al-Fitr**).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Festival
 Significance 
 
 
 
 

 Bakrid
 Bakrid is another name for Eid al-Adha, also known as the Festival of Sacrifice. It is one of the two major Islamic festivals, the other being Eid al-Fitr.
 
 

 Eid-Ul-Zuha (Eid al-Adha or the Festival of Sacrifice)
 
 
It commemorates the willingness of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) to sacrifice his son as an act of obedience to God's command.

 
 
 

 Muharram
 Unlike Eid al-Fitr, which is a festival of joy, Muharram is a solemn time, particularly for Shia Muslims, as it commemorates the martyrdom of Imam Hussain, the grandson of the Prophet Muhammad, in the Battle of Karbala.

questions.question: In Microsoft Excel, which chart type is best suited for comparing proportions or percentages of a whole?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pie Chart.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pie charts display **data as slices** of a circle, where each slice represents a category's contribution to the total.
 
• Example of Pie chart:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6642485d7b9e591179f165d9825b0a8c0420b4d72ceafb45bf3e2ec396e4f0b8.png]

__
 
• A **line chart** displays data points connected by straight lines. It is used to show trends over time or continuous data such as **stock prices, temperature changes, or sales growth.**
 
• A **bar chart** uses rectangular bars to represent data. It is suitable for comparing discrete categories or groups, such as **sales by region, product performance, or survey responses**.
 
• A **scatter chart** (scatter plot) uses Cartesian coordinates to display values for two variables for a set of data. It is ideal for showing the **relationship or correlation between two variables and identifying patterns or clusters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• Microsoft Excel was **first released in 1985 **for the Apple Macintosh. It was later released for Windows in **1987.**
 
• 
 
Excel supports **1,048,576 rows and 16,384 columns** in a single worksheet.

questions.question: Which Articles of the Constitution deal with citizenship?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Articles 5 to 11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 5 to 11 of the Indian Constitution deals with the Citizenship of India.__
 
• Article 5 of the Indian constitution deals with citizenship at the commencement of the Constitution.
 
• Article 6 of the Indian constitution deals with the citizenship of certain persons who have migrated from Pakistan.
 
• Article 7 of the Indian constitution deals with the citizenship of certain migrants to Pakistan.
 
• Article 8 of the Indian constitution deals with the citizenship of certain persons of Indian origin residing outside India.
 
• Article 9 of the Indian constitution says that "people voluntarily acquiring citizenship of a foreign country will not be citizens of India".
 
• Article 11 of the Indian constitution deals with Parliament to regulate the right of citizenship by law.

questions.question: According to the Census of India 2011, which of the following states is the most urbanised?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, Goa is the most urbanized state, with about **62.2%** of its population living in urban areas (Census 2011).
 
• Tamil Nadu had the highest urbanization rate among large states at **48.4%**, followed by Maharashtra and Gujarat.
 
• Notably, Kerala had a rapid increase in urbanization between 2001 and 2011, with **47.7%** of its population urbanized, primarily due to the reclassification of rural areas.
 
• Punjab had **37.5%** urbanization, while Himachal Pradesh remained one of the least urbanized states with just **10%** of its population living in urban areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2023 Estimates:** As per recent estimates, India's urban population is about **35-38%** of the total population. States like Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, and Gujarat continue to lead in urbanization.
 
• **Kerala & Goa:** Both states have seen further increases in urbanization due to development and tourism.
 
• The first full census in India was conducted in **1881** under British rule.
 
• In the **1881** Census of India, the **Madras Presidency** (now part of Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Kerala) was among the most urbanized regions.
 
• The first regular census in India was conducted in **1872** by British administrator **W.C. Plowden**. However, it was not synchronous across the entire country and is considered a **partial census.**
 
• **Mumbai** remains one of the most urbanized cities in India, with a population of over **20 million** (2023 estimates).

questions.question: The Palas were:

options.text: a dynasty that first appeared in Cambodia
a dynasty that appeared in eastern India
a dynasty that appeared in Puri
a dynasty that united eastern India and Burma

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A dynasty that appeared in eastern India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dynasty Overview:**

 
 
• Period: Ruled from the 8th to 12th centuries.
 
• Founder: Gopala established the dynasty around the 8th century.
 
• Regions: Primarily Bengal and parts of Bihar.
 
 
 
• **Religious and Cultural Contributions:**
 
 
• Buddhism: The Palas were prominent patrons of Mahayana Buddhism.
 
• Educational Institutions: Founded and supported renowned Buddhist universities like Nalanda and Vikramashila.
 
 
 
• **Key Rulers:**
 
 
• Dharma Pala (circa 770–810 CE): Consolidated and expanded the empire, strengthening its influence.
 
• Devapala (circa 810–850 CE): Furthered the empire's reach and prosperity.
 
 
 
• **Decline and Legacy:**
 
 
• The empire declined due to invasions by the Cholas and the rise of new regional powers, including the Senas.
 
• The Palas are remembered for their significant contributions to art, architecture, and the promotion of Buddhist learning and culture in the Indian subcontinent.

questions.question: On 7 November 2022, the Supreme Court of India upheld the reservations for the weaker sections (EWS). Which of the following amendments brought this reservation in the first place?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**103rd Amendment of the Constitution.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Introduction of EWS Reservation:**

 
 
• Objective: Provides 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) in educational institutions and government jobs.
 
• Criteria: Applies to individuals not covered by SC, ST, or OBC reservations, based on economic status.
 
 
 
• **Amendments to the Constitution:**
 
 
• Article 15: Allows for the provision of reservation in educational institutions for EWS.
 
• Article 16: Permits reservation in government employment for EWS.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility:**
 
 
• Income Limit: Individuals with annual income below ₹8 lakh or possessing less than 5 acres of land are eligible.
 
 
 
• **Impact:**
 
 
• Expansion: Increases the scope of affirmative action by including economically disadvantaged individuals who are not otherwise covered by existing reservation policies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
